# defuss-db API

> The API reference of defuss-db 3.3.0, a document database for the browser, Node.js and Bun: guides, then every documented function and method with its signature. Each link is a Markdown page; the same path with .json is its data.

## Guides

- [Introduction](guides/introduction.md)
- [Historical collections](guides/historical-collections.md)
- [Timestamps](guides/timestamps.md)
- [Opening](guides/opening.md)
- [Database](guides/database.md)
- [Collection mutations](guides/collection-mutations.md)
- [Collection reads](guides/collection-reads.md)
- [MongoDB syntax and schemas](guides/mongodb-syntax-and-schemas.md)
- [Schemas and validation](guides/schemas-and-validation.md)
- [Errors](guides/errors.md)
- [Archives and result caching](guides/archives-and-result-caching.md)
